connectionFields.obtainedHow: Upload the JSON key created for the Entro service account; keep its value in the operator vault.

operatorInputs.prompt: GCP organization domain
operatorInputs.purpose: Identifies the organization in the Entro form and in Entro's Terraform variables
operatorInputs.validation: Domain attached to the GCP organization, such as example.com

operatorInputs.prompt: GCP organization ID
operatorInputs.purpose: Organization whose IAM policy carries Entro's read-only role bindings
operatorInputs.validation: Numeric GCP organization ID as `gcloud organizations list` reports it

operatorInputs.prompt: GCP project ID for Entro onboarding
operatorInputs.purpose: Project the required APIs are enabled in and the Entro reader identity lives in
operatorInputs.validation: GCP project ID: 6-30 characters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens

operatorInputs.prompt: Name for the Entro reader service account
operatorInputs.purpose: Names the service account this run creates and grants Entro's read-only roles
operatorInputs.validation: Service account ID: 6-30 characters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens

prepSteps.title: Run the GCP pre-onboarding check
prepSteps.instruction: Save and run Entro's GCP pre-onboarding check so report.txt shows project access and logging before creating the reader identity.
prepSteps.evidence: report.txt lists organization projects with role and logging results

prepSteps.title: Enable Terraform-default GCP APIs
prepSteps.instruction: Run the generated, checksummed API artifact. It enables the pinned Terraform defaults on the host project and on active organization projects discovered from the cataloged organization ID; billing-dependent defaults follow the pinned Terraform condition without an API-selection prompt.
prepSteps.evidence: APIs & Services shows 8 host-project defaults, 3 organization-project defaults, and the 2 billing-dependent defaults where the Terraform condition applies

prepSteps.title: Create the Entro reader identity
prepSteps.instruction: Describe the requested service-account email first. Stop before grants if it already exists; otherwise create only the service account in the host project.
prepSteps.evidence: IAM & Admin → Service Accounts shows the newly created Entro reader account

prepSteps.title: Grant the Terraform-derived Entro IAM roles
prepSteps.instruction: Run the generated, checksummed IAM artifact after service-account creation. It creates an unused Terraform-compatible Entro Logging Role and grants that role plus the 12 pinned predefined organization roles.
prepSteps.evidence: Organization IAM shows the service account with the custom Entro Logging Role and 12 predefined role bindings

prepSteps.title: Configure organization audit logs
prepSteps.instruction: In the Google Cloud console, open https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/audit for the organization. Configure Data Read and Data Write audit logging for Secret Manager API, Cloud Functions API, and Identity and Access Management (IAM) API, preserving existing exempted principals and settings.
prepSteps.evidence: The organization Audit Logs page visibly shows Data Read and Data Write enabled for the three required services

operatorOnly.reason: The documented command route replaces the organization IAM policy; Connect keeps this organization-wide merge-sensitive change in the Google Cloud console
operatorOnly.evidence: The organization Audit Logs page shows Data Read and Data Write enabled for Secret Manager API, Cloud Functions API, and Identity and Access Management (IAM) API

prepSteps.title: Create the private key credential
prepSteps.instruction: For Console manual, create a JSON key on the Entro service account and vault the downloaded file. For Terraform automated, fill tf-var-files/create-service-account-key.tfvars; it sets service_account_key_create_condition=true and enable_workload_identity_federation=false.
prepSteps.evidence: A service-account private-key JSON file is stored in the operator vault

uncataloged.evidence: A service-account private-key JSON file is stored in the operator vault

typedActions.preview: The shell script has no vendor dry-run; checksum the Skill-held file then Approve
typedActions.target: GCP organization projects the operator can list
typedActions.expectedChange: report.txt lists projects with role and logging checks
typedActions.verification: report.txt exists and records Organization ID plus per-project results
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: No GCP mutation; delete local report.txt if stopping

typedActions.preview: The generated artifact has no vendor dry-run; checksum and review the Skill-held file. It will derive active organization projects from <organization_id>, enable 8 host-project defaults on <project_id>, 3 organization-project defaults, and the 2 billing-required defaults when the pinned Terraform billing condition is true.
typedActions.target: Host project <project_id> and active projects under GCP organization <organization_id>
typedActions.expectedChange: The host project has all 8 Terraform-default host services; active organization projects have all 3 organization-project services and, when billing-required defaults are enabled, both billing-dependent services
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Enabled APIs remain enabled; rollback intentionally does not disable shared services because other workloads may depend on them

script.version: Terraform-default GCP API enablement; generated from integrations/google-gcp/Entro GCP Terraform onboarding.zip at sha256:904b1ef405d86d59a759347dc3c45a0d512925b351a71ad7225f01c990a1bbe0

typedActions.preview: Run gcloud iam service-accounts describe <service_account_name>@<project_id>.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project <project_id>. If it exists, treat the name as a collision and stop before any IAM grants; do not reuse or modify it.
typedActions.mutation: gcloud iam service-accounts create <service_account_name> --project <project_id> --display-name "A service account for Entro Automatic Onboard"
typedActions.expectedChange: One Entro reader service account exists; this action creates no key and grants no role
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Delete the service account only if this run created it: gcloud iam service-accounts delete <service_account_name>@<project_id>.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project <project_id>

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Grant the Terraform-derived Entro IAM roles
typedActions.preview: Checksum and review the generated Skill-held artifact. It will select an unused entroLoggingRole_<1-1000> role ID, create the pinned Entro Logging Role, and add its binding plus exactly 12 predefined organization bindings; existing predefined bindings are left untouched.
typedActions.target: IAM policy for GCP organization <organization_id> and the Entro reader service account in project <project_id>
typedActions.expectedChange: An Entro Logging Role with the pinned Terraform permission set and exactly 12 predefined roles grants organization read access to the Entro reader service account
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Run ORGANIZATION_ID=<organization_id> PROJECT_ID=<project_id> SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAME=<service_account_name> bash integrations/google-gcp/entro-gcp-iam-grants.sh rollback; it removes only IAM bindings and the custom role created by this run
